case_rule.deterministic_case_pass: PASS only when every frozen expected invariant is PASS, replay/case identity matches, and no mandatory-coordinate or resource-matching violation exists.
case_rule.deterministic_case_fail: FAIL when any frozen expected invariant or mandatory coordinate is violated by the subject under a matched valid run.
case_rule.deterministic_case_cannot_check: CANNOT_CHECK when required identity, execution, evidence, mapping, or matching cannot be established; CANNOT_CHECK is not a pass.
case_rule.secondary_noncompensation: Secondary improvements never compensate a FAIL or CANNOT_CHECK on a mandatory coordinate.

capability_cell_rule.pass: A capability cell is PASS for a subject only if every frozen required case that references the cell is resolved PASS for that cell's applicable invariants.
capability_cell_rule.fail: A capability cell is FAIL if any required matched case establishes a mandatory invariant violation attributable to that cell.
capability_cell_rule.cannot_check: A capability cell is CANNOT_CHECK if no matched case establishes FAIL but at least one required case remains unresolved or unmatched.

paired_rule.v2_noninferior: No frozen V1 capability cell may be worse for V2 on any mandatory/conditional applicable coordinate. Secondary cost/reach comparisons are reported separately.
paired_rule.v2_strict_gain: At least one capability cell or registered secondary endpoint improves for V2 while every mandatory/conditional applicable cell remains noninferior.
paired_rule.v1_noninferior: V2 shows no protected gain and/or V1 is better on at least one applicable endpoint without V1 mandatory regression.
paired_rule.v2_regression: Any V1 capability cell that is validly PASS for V1 but FAIL or unjustifiably CANNOT_CHECK for V2 on a mandatory/conditional applicable coordinate is a V2 capability regression.
paired_rule.overreach: A simple-control case in which V2 performs unnecessary higher-level work/escalation without scientific gain is reported as V2_COMPLEXITY_OR_ESCALATION_OVERREACH even if the final answer is correct.

semantic_adjudication.presentation: V1/V2 or comparator outputs are stripped of subject labels and presented in randomized order with the frozen case/criterion and evidence needed to judge the invariant.
semantic_adjudication.independence: The first two reviewers may not be the sole case authors, V2 subject authors, or dependent through the same declared model/data/source when that dependence is material to the criterion.
semantic_adjudication.agreement: Two agreeing independent labels decide the invariant.
semantic_adjudication.disagreement: A third independently bound adjudicator receives the same blinded packet. Majority decides; absence of a valid majority is CANNOT_CHECK.
semantic_adjudication.confidence: Reviewer confidence is descriptive only and cannot convert FAIL/CANNOT_CHECK to PASS.
semantic_adjudication.rationale: Each semantic label must cite the exact source span, graph relation, or obstruction/witness supporting the judgment.
semantic_adjudication.authority: Adjudication establishes an evaluator result under this frozen criterion only; it grants no scientific truth, architecture, novelty, adoption, or publication authority.

mutation_rule: Any scoring, adjudication, coordinate, aggregation, or semantic rubric change after paired output access creates a new protocol/run identity.
